main.aml_alert: Anti-money-laundering alerts raised on customers with scenario, score, disposition and analyst; answers which customers were flagged for suspicious activity.
main.aml_sanctions_hit: Payments matched against sanctions lists with match score and clearance flag; answers which payments hit a sanctions screen.
main.cpty_mstr: Legacy counterparty master with name, country code and active flag; answers basic counterparty identity.
main.dim_counterparty: Trading counterparties with LEI, country, sector, credit rating and active flag; answers who we trade with and how they are rated.
main.dim_customer: Customers with number, segment, relationship manager and onboarding date; answers who our customers are.
main.dim_customer_old: Superseded copy of the customer dimension; not for analysis.
main.fx_rate_daily: Daily exchange rates between currency pairs with source; answers what the exchange rate was on a given day.
main.gl_daily_balance: Opening balance, debits, credits and closing balance per account per entity per day; answers account balances over time.
main.gl_journal_header: Posted general ledger journals with entity, period, source, description and status; answers which journals were posted and when.
main.gl_journal_line: Debit and credit lines of each journal by account, cost centre and currency; answers what was booked to each account.
main.gl_journal_line_bkp: Backup copy of journal lines; not for analysis.
main.gl_journal_line_v2: Migration copy of journal lines; not for analysis.
main.gl_period: Fiscal periods with start and end dates and whether closed; answers which accounting periods are open or closed.
main.kyc_review: Know-your-customer reviews with risk rating, politically-exposed flag and outcome; answers which customers were reviewed and their risk rating.
main.lnd_loan: Loans issued to customers with product, principal, rate, origination and maturity dates and status; answers what we have lent and to whom.
main.lnd_provision: Expected credit loss provisions per loan by date and impairment stage; answers how much we expect to lose on each loan.
main.lnd_repayment_schedule: Scheduled loan instalments with amounts due, paid date and days past due; answers which repayments are late or missed.
main.pay_payment: Customer payments with amounts, currency, channel, status and return code; answers what payments were made and which were returned.
main.ref_chart_of_accounts: The chart of accounts hierarchy with code, name, type and posting flag; answers what each account is.
main.ref_cost_centre: Cost centres per legal entity; answers which cost centre a charge belongs to.
main.ref_currency: Reference list of currencies with minor units; answers what a currency code means.
main.ref_instrument: Financial instruments with ISIN, ticker, asset class, currency and maturity; answers what securities we trade.
main.ref_legal_entity: Legal entities with jurisdiction and functional currency; answers which company books belong to.
main.stg_payment: Raw staged payments before transformation; not for analysis.
main.stg_trade: Raw staged trades before transformation; not for analysis.
main.trd_pnl_daily: Daily realised and unrealised profit and loss, fees and total per book and entity; answers how much was made or lost each day.
main.trd_position: Holdings per instrument, entity and book on a date with quantity, average cost, market value and unrealised P&L; answers what we hold and its value.
main.trd_position_tmp: Temporary working copy of positions; not for analysis.
main.trd_settlement: Settlement outcome of each trade with date, amount, status and failure reason; answers which trades settled or failed.
main.trd_trade: Executed trades with instrument, counterparty, entity, dates, side, quantity, price and notional; answers what was traded, with whom and for how much.
main.trd_trade_old: Superseded copy of trades; not for analysis.
main.v_counterparty_exposure: Total market value held against each counterparty with its rating; answers how much we are exposed to each party.
main.v_expected_credit_loss: Total expected credit loss by date and impairment stage; answers how much we expect to lose on lending.
main.v_failed_settlements: Trades whose settlement failed, with amount and reason; answers which deals did not complete.
main.v_fx_rate_as_of: Exchange rates with the date range each was valid; answers what rate applied on any given day.
main.v_loans_in_arrears: Loans with overdue repayments, days past due and overdue amount per customer; answers which borrowers are behind.
main.v_payment_returns: Count of returned payments by channel and return code; answers which payments bounced and why.
main.v_trial_balance: Closing balance per account per date; answers whether the books balance.
main.v_unbalanced_journals: Journals whose debits do not equal credits; answers which entries do not add up.
